text: 港交所正式发布截至9月30日的前三季度业绩公告。财报显示，港交所前九个月营收、股东利润双双刷新历史同期最高，但第三季度单季利润出现同比微跌；IPO募资热火朝天、北向资金交投爆发，而内地资金南下港股的成交显著收缩。
text_en: HKEX officially released its results announcement for the first three quarters ended September 30. The financial report shows that HKEX's revenue and profit attributable to shareholders for the first nine months both hit record highs for the same period, but third-quarter profit alone edged down year on year; IPO fundraising was booming and Northbound trading surged, while Southbound trading by mainland funds in Hong Kong stocks contracted significantly.
